Proposition
[Disjoint geodesic realization] 1. Proposition 5.3.3\group hyperbolic surfacesSource: thurston:page-0101 Pairwise disjoint, homotopically distinct essential simple closed curves on a closed hyperbolic surface are represented by pairwise disjoint simple closed geodesics.
Proof

\sketch Intersecting lifts have linked distinct endpoints on the circle at infinity; finite-distance homotopies cannot change endpoints, so the intersection cannot be removed. Applying the same argument to distinct lifts proves simplicity.

□
